messages:
incident-bot: ALERT resolved - svc:redwood-inference (api-serve) | region:us-east-1 | 2026-03-15T09:12:00Z to 2026-03-15T11:05:00Z | impact: degraded throughput for /v1/generate. Please assess customer impact and SLA eligibility. Ticket: INC-2026-0321
Priya Kaur: on it. quick summary: autoscaler failed to recover after upstream node drain, requests queued -> 2h 53m total partial outage window. moving to mitigation channel.
Ethan Li: FYI we forced failover to hot-standby at 10:35 UTC, requests started draining by 10:48. Root cause: kernel panic on node pool due to driver mismatch (provider-side).
Maya Ortiz: any idea how many customers hit errors vs slowdown? need counts to scope support comms.
Priya Kaur: initial estimate: 47 live API keys had >5% 5xx rate, 312 keys saw latency spikes >2s. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream. Roughly 4.2M tokens served during window vs typical 6.1M -> ~31% token reduction.
Logan Reed: ok billing - we'll need a list of customers with sustained service degradation, their invoice cycle, and usage during the window. Can someone attach the raw query or CSV?
Priya Kaur: dropping a short machine-readable summary below (for billing/support):
```
incident_id: INC-2026-0321
start: 2026-03-15T09:12:00Z
mitigation_start: 2026-03-15T10:35:00Z
fully_serving: 2026-03-15T11:05:00Z
downtime_effective: 2h53m
affected_endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream
estimated_customers_high_error: 47
estimated_customers_latency_only: 312
notes: partial degradation; many requests queued but not permanently failed
```
Ethan Li: technical note for oncall-next: autoscaler config change pushed at 09:05 (new driver), provider drained nodes at 09:10, drifted -> panic around 09:12. Rolling back driver prevented further panics. Need provider postmortem.
Aisha Gomez: product asks for a short status-page blurb and a customer email draft. Suggest this wording for the public page: "We experienced degraded inference performance in us-east-1 between 09:12 and 11:05 UTC on 2026-03-15. Some requests returned errors or experienced higher latency. Full service was restored by 11:05 UTC. We're continuing to investigate root cause and will provide follow-ups." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maya Ortiz: support draft for customers impacted (short, to be personalized):
"Hi — We’re reaching out because you may have experienced degraded API performance today in our us-east-1 region between 09:12 and 11:05 UTC. Our team has restored normal service and we’re investigating. If you saw errors or higher latency that affected your workflows, reply and we’ll prioritize a review of your usage and discuss service compensation if eligible"
Jordan (legal): copy looks fine. Keep compensation language conditional; no promises. Use "service compensation" or "service credit" depending on billing team's calc.
Logan Reed: got it. Per policy (see https://redwood.internal/policy/sla) service credits apply when availability < 99.9% for the billing period or outage window >= 4h, or significant partial degradation as reviewed. This window is ~2.9h so borderline; we'll run the per-customer assessment and propose credits where degradation materially impacted usage and cost.
Priya Kaur: agreed. Running a query now to produce precise per-customer token delta and 5xx counts. ETA 30m. tagging @Logan for CSV handoff.
deploy-bot: Deployment rollback job #deploy-3345 completed at 2026-03-15T10:40:12Z (status: success).
Ethan Li: note: we observed increased KV cache misses during the window which amplified token cost. Might include in the impact note for advanced customers.
Maya Ortiz: Support will prepare a templated outbound and a PSAT (personalized support action ticket) for top-20 customers. Will wait for CSV to populate customer names + invoices.
Logan Reed: when you share CSV include: customer_id, api_key, invoice_cycle, tokens_during_window, avg_tokens_prior_24h, 5xx_count. I’ll compute pro-rated credits and draft billing adjustments.
Priya Kaur: uploaded CSV to /secure/incidents/INC-2026-0321/affected_customers.csv (internal link). Summary: 8 enterprise customers had >20% token reduction and >100 5xx; those are highest priority.
Maya Ortiz: starting outreach to top-8 now, will paste thread of customer replies here.
Aisha Gomez: product follow-up — recommend status page update include "we will evaluate compensation for materially impacted customers and reach out directly". Keeps public transparency without specifics.
Logan Reed: preparing a short billing note for AR: "We are evaluating service compensation for customers impacted by the us-east-1 degradation on 2026-03-15. Affected accounts identified; proposed credits will be computed pro-rata based on token usage during the window. Expect a follow-up with credit amounts within 72 hours."
Jordan (legal): approve that text. Add line: "All credits are subject to the terms of the signed agreement and Redwood's SLA policy."
Priya Kaur: final oncall notes: will escalate vendor postmortem, put autoscaler driver roll-out on hold org-wide until patch validated, create a follow-up status update in 24h. Handoff to oncall-next @Ethan on duty.
incident-bot: Handoff: oncall-next assigned -> Ethan Li | next_checkin: 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z | link: /incidents/INC-2026-0321/handoff
Ethan Li: taking handoff. I’ll monitor errors and assist billing with any technical clarifications.
Priya Kaur: closing this thread for primary incident coordination. Billing and support will continue comms off-thread. Will post final credit decisions here once Logan completes calculations. Thanks all. :heart:
